entry.name: Machine Learning Crash Course
entry.note: Google's refreshed MLCC with interactive visuals and Keras exercises

reading.format: A series of animated videos, interactive visualizations, and hands-on practice exercises, with self-contained modules.
reading.summary: Machine Learning Crash Course is a fast-paced, practical introduction to machine learning. It uses animated videos, interactive visualizations, and hands-on practice exercises. The refreshed version covers recent advances in AI and focuses on interactive learning.
reading.audience: It is for people new to machine learning, who should complete modules in order, and for those with prior experience, who can skip directly to topics they want to learn.
